record.source_text:
If business assets of a business (permanent establishment) located in Austria are transferred abroad to another business (permanent establishment), the business assets transferred abroad shall be measured at the values that would have been applied in the case of a supply or other service to a business entirely independent of the taxpayer, if

— the foreign business belongs to the same taxpayer,
— the taxpayer is a co-entrepreneur of the foreign business,
— the taxpayer holds a substantial interest, i.e. more than 25%, in the foreign corporation, or
— the same persons exercise management or control over both businesses or have influence on them.
